resources.string: What do you want your phone to do?
It operates on another screen in the background, you can continue using your phone
Follow known path with map, otherwise look at the screen
No map, look at the screen every step
Switched to Auto: prioritize known path, look at screen if failed
Switched to View image: look at the screen every step
After enabling, it will operate on your own screen, you can see every step. Apps like JD.com and Taobao can only run this way.
Managed mode on: will operate on your own screen
Managed mode off: back to background virtual screen
Reads the control tree on the virtual display so PhoneGo knows what each button is, instead of blindly clicking coordinates.
%1$s (%2$s)\nNew map will be written to %1$s.yaml; after crawling it won\'t automatically override the one currently in use—then tap "Pin to use this one" in the list.
✅ Can crawl 📌 Existing map ⚠️ Might fail (try anyway) ⛔ Tried, failed\nCrawling runs on the virtual screen, the phone can still be used normally.
